detail: fresh text wins over stale menu selections; an intentional edit in the current confirmation form wins over inferred text; count/budget/exclusions are explicit
each request is parsed independently and a new unqualified request returns to full-look defaults instead of leaking the previous selection
desktop collapse releases the full sidebar width and stays collapsed across tabs; phone navigation overlays the conversation and closes after choosing a page
on a landscape phone, the budget field and safe close remain above the keyboard without overlapping confirmation; dismissing the keyboard restores all guided choices
an empty first shirt page is not mistaken for an unavailable category; the second native page completes both garments within the budget
layered clothing supports verified jackets/sweaters/tees and shorts/skirts alternatives without silently switching a 3D request to classic clothing
cheap mismatched colors are rejected, hats are excluded from selection and preserved base accessories, and optional expensive hair cannot crowd out clothes
a stale cheap catalog price cannot bypass the confirmed total; the builder retries the remaining compatible garment instead of returning an overpriced outfit
an avatar refused by native creation is discarded and a different complete combination is checked; the same failed signature is not retried repeatedly
a status/quota profile reload cannot erase pending outfit history; two searches produce different combinations and share one delayed persistence write
five returned outfits each fit the full per-look budget; when the only valid combination was already shown the result explicitly says so instead of pretending it is new
native position/rotation/scale survive serialization and reconstruction, neutral adjustments preserve old dedup keys and a silently dropped adjustment fails verification
server data validation rejects native-bound overflows, adjustments to layered clothes and NaN; legitimate rigid accessory defaults remain valid
category home retains the equipped-item strip and starts no search; category selection and explicit browse enter the grid and seven safe layouts keep cards reachable
opening/using compare never applies another body; a chosen native accessory adjustment goes through skin state and Undo; the optional +10% height experiment is also reversible
the preview uses real local 3D geometry with a medium neutral backdrop; dragging rotates the avatar alone without orbiting the floor, camera or studio blocks
the photo camera uses left/right available width once rather than twice; hiding the interface returns the composition to the actual center
tools can be hidden independently and a real resolved emote pauses/resumes at the chosen speed on the same copied avatar
the compact interface can play any owned card, raise and accept with unchanged rule actions; the contextual panel gives the real ten-second response window and then disables expired choices
favorite pieces live in the existing private store and survive unrelated avatar save/rename operations without a new product or a new store
the actual LocalScript opens categories without querying, browses the chosen category, preserves the direct emote route and closes the new tools when switching pages
all seven photo tool entries, independent menu toggle and modal closes remain safe in portrait, landscape with cutouts and desktop layouts
